question: After years of wandering Babur seized Kabul in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1504**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Babur **was a **Timurid prince **who founded the **Mughal Empire in India**. He was born in Fergana, present-day Uzbekistan.
 
• Before he seized Kabul, Babur had faced several defeats and had lost his ancestral kingdom of Fergana in Central Asia.
